title.suggested: Allen Apologizes to the New York Clipper

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Tom Allen had published an apology admitting he had written unjust criticism of the New York Clipper, and that a Clipper interview with him might soon follow.

metadata.notes: No page image, so masthead and date cannot be checked; source file name says Aug 11, 1876. Before 1878-12, so not the Post-Dispatch.

facts.fact: Allen published an apology (amende honorable) admitting he had written unjust criticism of the New York Clipper

notes: Current summary mentions Mike McCoole and Jem Mace, who are not in the item.
